title: Climate aware lending allocation under NGFS scenarios - A Monte Carlo approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.00051v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a framework to assess loan portfolio budget in credit portfolios exposed to climate risk over a 3-5 year horizon. Using short-term scenarios from the NGFS, the approach translates transition and physical risk pathways into changes in obligor default risk. Firm performance is modeled within a structural credit risk framework where scenario-dependent climate shocks adjust the drift of firm value dynamics. Defaults occur when firm value falls below a liability threshold. Joint defaults are simulated using Monte Carlo methods with dependence captured via principal components. Resulting default-probability estimates inform a constrained optimization used to examine lending allocation across exposures. Climate scenario choice affects model-implied default probabilities and the resulting risk-return tradeoff across obligors and sectors. The results show scenario-specific differences in default-probability distributions, uppe

translated_title: NGFS情景下气候感知的贷款配置——一种蒙特卡洛方法
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个框架，用于在3-5年的时间范围内评估暴露于气候风险的信贷组合中的贷款组合预算。该方法利用NGFS的短期情景，将转型风险和物理风险路径转化为债务人违约风险的变化。企业经营表现被建模于结构化信用风险框架之中，其中依赖于情景的气候冲击会调整企业价值动态的漂移项。当企业价值跌破负债阈值时即发生违约。联合违约通过蒙特卡洛方法进行模拟，其相关性通过主成分分析加以刻画。由此得到的违约概率估计为约束优化提供输入，用于研究各风险暴露之间的贷款配置。气候情景的选择会影响模型隐含的违约概率，以及债务人和各行业之间由此产生的风险-收益权衡。结果显示违约概率分布存在情景特定的差异……
tldr: 本文提出一个将NGFS短期气候情景与蒙特卡洛模拟相结合的结构化信用风险框架，把气候转型与物理风险转化为借款人违约概率的变化，并通过约束优化为气候风险下的贷款配置提供决策依据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structural credit risk framework combining NGFS short-term climate scenarios with Monte Carlo simulation, translating climate transition and physical risks into borrower default probabilities and informing lending allocation decisions through constrained optimization.
